blocks.title: A real detail, not a car wash with extra steps.
body: Michigan is hard on a car. Road salt ends up in the floor mats, pollen in the vents and iron fallout bonded to the paint. A drive-through wash moves dirt around. **A Refresh My Ride detail removes it.**

Every package follows a step-by-step process. On our deeper packages, interiors are extracted, steamed and deodorized, not just vacuumed. Wherever a sealant goes on, the paint gets a full decontamination first.
Book it however it fits your week: at our Clinton Township shop, in your driveway with mobile service, or hand us the keys with pick-up and drop-off valet.
checks: **Interior deep clean.** Hot water extraction, steam and odor removal for seats, carpet and trim.
**Exterior decontamination.** Iron, clay bar, bug, tar and sap removed, not buried under wax.
**Machine polishing.** Polish & Protect and Luxury Refresh add a one-step machine polish for light swirls and scratches. Heavier work is [paint correction](/paint-correction/).

faqIntro: Straight answers about what a detail includes, what it costs and how long it takes. If yours is not here, call or text [(586) 400-1303](tel:+15864001303).

faq.q: What is the difference between a car detail and a car wash?
faq.a:
A car wash removes loose dirt from the outside of the car in a few minutes. A detail is hours of hands-on cleaning that covers every surface.

On the exterior, that means a full decontamination before any sealant goes on. On the interior, it means vacuuming every crevice, cleaning all the surfaces and touchpoints and, on our deeper packages, steam cleaning, conditioning and extracting the seats and carpet. A wash makes a car look clean from ten feet. A detail makes it clean up close.

faq.q: How much does car detailing cost in Clinton Township?
faq.a:
Interior details are from $184.99, exterior details from $139.99 and full interior and exterior packages from $249.99, all priced for a coupe or sedan in average condition. Our longest package, the Luxury Refresh, is from $439.99. SUVs and trucks are quoted for their size.

If your vehicle needs more than the package covers, such as heavy pet hair or set-in stains, we explain the adjustment and get your approval before work begins. Financing is available through Affirm and Klarna.

faq.q: How long does a detail take?
faq.a:
It depends on the package and the vehicle. An exterior Wash & Seal takes about 1.5 hours, a Premium Interior Detail about 2 hours and a full Signature Refresh about 5 hours. Packages with machine polishing take longer: about 7 hours for a Luxury Refresh. Larger vehicles add time.

We give you a time estimate when you book. If you use our pick-up and drop-off valet service, you do not have to wait at all.

faq.q: Do you offer mobile detailing, or do I have to come to the shop?
faq.a:
Both, plus a third option. You can drop your vehicle at our Clinton Township shop. We can come to your home or workplace with mobile detailing. Or we can pick your vehicle up, detail it at the shop and bring it back with our valet service.

Mobile appointments need a driveway or parking spot with room to work around the vehicle. We confirm the details when you book.

faq.q: Can you remove pet hair, stains and odors?
faq.a:
Yes. The Executive Interior Detail, Signature Refresh and Luxury Refresh include steam cleaning and a two step shampoo process. That lifts embedded pet hair, food and drink stains, and the sources of most odors out of the seats and carpet, instead of covering them with fragrance.

Some stains are permanent, such as dye transfer or old bleach marks, and we tell you honestly during the walkaround what will and will not come out. Heavy pet hair or biohazard cleanup may add time and cost, which we always confirm with you before work begins.

faq.q: How often should I get my car detailed?
faq.a:
For most drivers in Michigan, a full detail once or twice a year keeps road salt, pollen and UV damage from building up. Time it around the end of winter and the end of summer.

If you have kids, pets or a long commute, a maintenance detail every one to three months keeps the car from ever getting bad enough to need a full restoration again. Ask us about our maintenance plans, which lock in a lower per-visit price for regular service.

faq.q: Do I need to clean out my car before the appointment?
faq.a:
Please remove personal items, valuables, car seats and anything you want to keep from the cabin and trunk before we start. You do not need to clean anything. That is our job.

Clearing out loose belongings lets our technicians get to every surface and protects your things. If you forget something, we set it aside for you.

faq.q: Do you detail trucks, SUVs and high-end vehicles?
faq.a:
Yes. We work on everything from daily driver sedans to full-size trucks, three-row SUVs, and high-end and exotic vehicles. Larger vehicles are quoted at a higher tier because there is simply more surface to clean.

Our technicians are trained on the leather, wood and delicate trim found in higher-end interiors.

faq.q: Should I get a detail before a ceramic coating?
faq.a:
No. Every [ceramic coating](/ceramic-coating/) we install already includes the decontamination and paint prep the coating needs, so you do not need to book a separate detail first.

If you want the interior handled at the same time, our Signature Refresh or Luxury Refresh pairs well with a coating appointment. Mention it when you ask for your quote.

Our shop is at 33115 Louise Ave in Clinton Township, on the north side of 14 Mile Road, just east of Kelly Road. We serve Macomb and Oakland counties, and mobile and valet reach about 30 to 40 minutes from the shop. That includes Sterling Heights, Shelby Township, Macomb Township, Chesterfield, Mount Clemens, Roseville, St. Clair Shores, Rochester Hills, Troy and Birmingham. See [all service areas](/service-areas/).

If you are near the edge of that range, call or text us and we will let you know.
